Name: Elhanan, Son of Jair
Summary: Son of Jair who slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 20:5: Son of Jair who slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elhanan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
